input.quote: AbbVie shall have the right to grant sublicenses (or further rights of reference), through multiple tiers of Sublicensees, under the licenses and rights of reference granted in Sections 5.1.1, 5.1.2 and 5.1.3, to its Affiliates and other Persons
input.rationale: The grant to us in Section 5.1.3 is an exclusive licence (and right of reference) to Exploit the Licensed Compounds and Products, with an express right under Section 5.3 to sublicense through multiple tiers to our Affiliates and other Persons (covering contractors/Third Party Providers), and Section 13.16 confirms we may use Affiliates to perform. Nothing makes the licence revocable at Harpoon's discretion: Harpoon may terminate only for uncured material breach (Section 12.2, 90-day cure, subject to the Section 12.2.3 limitation) or insolvency, while at-will termination in Section 12.3 runs in our favour, and on expiry of the Term the Section 5.1.3 grants become "non-exclusive, fully-paid, royalty-free and irrevocable" (Section 12.1.2). Section 13.4.1 permits assignment without consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger or sale of stock/assets, and binds the grant on Harpoon's successors. This meets the preferred position on affiliates/contractors, irrevocability and successor transfer; no redline needed.
